description.en: Specifies whether to generate the text step by step.

description.zh: 提示词，需要帮写的主题
description.en: The prompt, which specifies the subject for the AI to write about.

description.zh: 提示词模式，如：PE：高级模式，Template：模板模式
description.en: The prompt pattern. For example, PE indicates the advanced pattern and Template indicates the template pattern.

description.zh: 上一次表单的写作参数，键值对形式
description.en: The writing parameters from the previous form, specified as key-value pairs.

description.zh: 写作场景：government(政务)、media(传媒)、market(营销)、office(办公)、custom(自定义)
description.en: The writing scenario. Valid values: government, media, market, office, and custom.

description.zh: 写作文体唯一标识KEY，可通过[ListWritingStyles](~~2922609~~)接口获取对应写作场景下的文体列表
description.en: The unique key for the writing style. Call the [ListWritingStyles](~~2922609~~) operation to get a list of styles for the specified scenario.
